tasks.title: Scope and source inventory
tasks.acceptance: Record every authorized group, admin, visibility, consent route, expected throughput and retention; no user history is imported

tasks.title: Community constitution
tasks.acceptance: Ratify C01–C14 in architecture/constitution.yaml with community owner and independent privacy reviewer

tasks.title: Data categories
tasks.acceptance: Define PUBLIC_APPROVED, MEMBER_CONSENTED, INTERNAL_RESTRICTED, PRIVATE_UNKNOWN and rules for model egress

tasks.title: Evaluation fixture
tasks.acceptance: Create >=200 labeled synthetic/consented cases: 60 RU, 60 EN, 40 mixed, 40 adversarial; immutable IDs and sources

tasks.title: Reference implementations
tasks.acceptance: Pin comparable artifacts: unread for cited retrieval, Telebrief for digest, TelAnalysis for stats and TGTLDR for catch-up

tasks.title: Threat model
tasks.acceptance: Threat-model account takeover, data exfiltration, prompt injection, profiling, provider logs, poisoned citations, deletion, double introductions

tasks.title: Capacity baseline
tasks.acceptance: Define representative corpus: 100k messages, 2k episodes, 200 docs, 100 members; record measured laptop/VPS environment

tasks.title: External service gate
tasks.acceptance: Do not transmit identifiable community content to trial NVIDIA or free d3; obtain approved terms and DPA for real data or keep local

tasks.title: License audit
tasks.acceptance: Record library/model license, commercial permission and redistributed components; no copy/paste from noncommercial projects

tasks.title: Approval signoff
tasks.acceptance: Approve scope, retention, consent text, test data, and authority roles before implementation

tasks.title: Inspect before bootstrap
tasks.acceptance: Read existing AGENTS.md, lockfile, CI, repo permissions, task tracker; preserve all existing content

tasks.title: Single tracker
tasks.acceptance: Use GitHub Issues as sole authoritative status; Markdown checkbox plan is specification only; never close items merely by editing file

tasks.title: Mission metadata
tasks.acceptance: Commit delivery/mission.json mapping requirements REQ-01..REQ-12 to issue IDs after issue creation

tasks.title: Create phase epics
tasks.acceptance: Create exactly P00..P12 epic issues, and 10 implementation issues per phase with predecessor and criterion; keep IDs in taskmap.json

tasks.title: Initialize code
tasks.acceptance: Adopt Python 3.12, uv project, Ruff, mypy, pytest and pinned uv.lock; prohibit floating production dependencies

tasks.title: AAA constitution
tasks.acceptance: Install C01..C14 invariants and roles; classify E0..E5 external effects and R0..R4 risks

tasks.title: Ports/contracts
tasks.acceptance: Create versioned connectors for Telegram, embedder, classifier, synthesizer, storage, identity and notifications

tasks.title: Independent validation
tasks.acceptance: CI requires types, unit, contract, ACL/replay, migration and architecture import tests; verifier identity differs from builder

tasks.title: Workcell fences
tasks.acceptance: Each parallel agent gets isolated worktree and explicit read/write glob; shared schema/lockfiles modified by integrator only

tasks.title: Reproducible releases
tasks.acceptance: Each candidate records commit SHA, lock hash, config schema, policy hash, migration ID and rollback artifact

tasks.title: SQLite schema
tasks.acceptance: Build tables: communities, memberships, sources, raw_events, messages, conversations, documents, excerpts, evidence

tasks.title: Domain identity
tasks.acceptance: Add persons, telegram_identities, consent, skill_claims, needs, offers, relationships, introductions

tasks.title: Access-control schema
tasks.acceptance: Every source and derivative has community_id, visibility, permitted_roles, restriction version, expiry/deletion references

tasks.title: Time model
tasks.acceptance: Store event_at, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to and supersedes_id for temporal knowledge

tasks.title: FTS5 indexes
tasks.acceptance: Create secure FTS5 projections keyed by evidence_id; normalize Unicode NFC, casefold and store Cyrillic tokens

tasks.title: Vector staging
tasks.acceptance: Add embeddings table with model_id, dimension, input_type, content_hash, version; reject incompatible dimensions

tasks.title: Job ledger
tasks.acceptance: Add durable jobs with state, lease_owner, lease_until, attempts, next_run; unique job dedup key

tasks.title: Effect outbox
tasks.acceptance: Add effect_intents and delivery receipts with UUID effect_id; never claim exactly-once external Telegram delivery

tasks.title: Migrations and rollback
tasks.acceptance: Create additive forward migration and backup/restore path; run migrations on a disposable copy

tasks.title: ACL red-team tests
tasks.acceptance: 100% of negative ACL tests deny cross-community, deleted, withdrawn, unapproved profile data

tasks.title: Bot setup
tasks.acceptance: aiogram long polling, one supervisor process, one bot token; document privacy mode and group notice

tasks.title: Authorized source registry
tasks.acceptance: Only collect group IDs explicitly enabled by authorized admin; no unlisted chats

tasks.title: Event idempotency
tasks.acceptance: Unique key (source_platform, chat_id, message_id, edit_revision) with duplicate-replay tests

tasks.title: Message normalization
tasks.acceptance: Text, text_entities, captions, sender pseudonym IDs, topic_id, reply_to, timestamp, edit metadata, source deep link

tasks.title: Conversation reconstruction
tasks.acceptance: Rebuild replies and forum topics deterministically; link orphan replies without fabricating parent content

tasks.title: JSON importer
tasks.acceptance: Support Desktop result.json and its mixed text arrays; accept upload only from privileged admin with provenance

tasks.title: Sync high-water mark
tasks.acceptance: Store last accepted update checkpoint only after local transaction commits

tasks.title: Deletion/edit handling
tasks.acceptance: Update source and mark derivatives stale; bot deletion blind spots documented and reconciliation job supported

tasks.title: Media metadata
tasks.acceptance: Store file IDs/media types only until media retention and consent are approved

tasks.title: Replay chaos tests
tasks.acceptance: Replay 100k mixed events with duplicates and out-of-order edits; compare resulting state hashes

tasks.title: Provider metadata probe
tasks.acceptance: Implement GET models/info/keys status with no content; fail closed when model ID/version/limits differ

tasks.title: Outbound policy guard
tasks.acceptance: Classifier adapter accepts only PUBLIC_APPROVED or separately authorized/redacted content; forbid arbitrary text from private groups

tasks.title: Pseudonymize eligible input
tasks.acceptance: Strip handles, phone, emails, credentials, URLs with tokens, personal names where reliably detectable; block unsanitizable input

tasks.title: Structured question schema
tasks.acceptance: Use fixed `choice` primary_intent and `noul` help_request, offer, answer_candidate; no open-ended generation

tasks.title: Request cap
tasks.acceptance: One message per call; 3 question types max; 1200 Unicode character state cap; cache by salted content digest+schema version

tasks.title: Typed response parser
tasks.acceptance: Verify model==vllm-sr/d3-turbo, recognized choice labels, finite probabilities and all required answers

tasks.title: Decision thresholds
tasks.acceptance: Publish help candidate at p>=0.80 as private suggestion only; 0.50..0.80 review; lower discard; never infer competence

tasks.title: Quota behavior
tasks.acceptance: On 429 respect Retry-After + jitter, max 3 retries; on 401/403/422/503/504 mark deferred/manual without interrupting ingestion

tasks.title: Fallback classifier
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic text patterns for explicit question/help offer and private /ask commands; uncertain messages are not silently promoted

tasks.title: Gold classification benchmark
tasks.acceptance: Per-language macro-F1 >=0.80, help-request recall >=0.90 on labeled set; else human review and no auto alerts

tasks.title: NVIDIA adapter
tasks.acceptance: POST integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/embeddings with model=nvidia/nemotron-3.5-embed-1b

tasks.title: Embedding contract
tasks.acceptance: Passage for index, query for retrieval, dimensions=1024, encoding_format=float, truncate=NONE; reject dimension mismatch

tasks.title: Content segmentation
tasks.acceptance: Group conversations as coherent episodes; text chunks target 350 tokens, max 600, 70-token overlap for long documents

tasks.title: Egress approval
tasks.acceptance: Embed only PUBLIC_APPROVED or specifically authorized, redacted content; synthetic demo unrestricted within trial terms

tasks.title: Caching
tasks.acceptance: Cache by SHA256 of normalized allowed text+model+dim+purpose+policy version; never share cross-tenant embeddings

tasks.title: SQLite vector store
tasks.acceptance: Store vectors and provenance with sqlite-vec; query only authorized source IDs before ranking/exposing results

tasks.title: Exact search fallback
tasks.acceptance: When provider is down or vector unavailable, return FTS5 search with metadata rather than fake semantic results

tasks.title: Fusion
tasks.acceptance: Retrieve FTS top 40 and vector top 40, fuse RRF(k=60), then source-expand to 30 evidence passages

tasks.title: Citation verifier
tasks.acceptance: Before response require passage IDs map to accessible unchanged excerpts; stale or deleted evidence excluded

tasks.title: Benchmark and model versioning
tasks.acceptance: Recall@10 >=0.85 and citation precision >=0.95 vs 200-case set; 1024-vs-2048 ablation logged; any model change reindexes

tasks.title: Member identity
tasks.acceptance: Use authorized Telegram IDs and membership checks for /ask; do not trust free-form chat IDs from request

tasks.title: Retrieval gate
tasks.acceptance: All candidate source IDs are ACL-filtered before snippet extraction; test hidden-source contamination

tasks.title: Extractive answer template
tasks.acceptance: Return concise quote/snippet, source, date and uncertainty; no invented synthesis when evidence conflicts

tasks.title: Insufficient evidence
tasks.acceptance: When top evidence under threshold or contradicts, clearly return no reliable answer and optional expert search

tasks.title: Exact source references
tasks.acceptance: Telegram t.me deep links and meeting mm:ss references; handle inaccessible links gracefully

tasks.title: Bilingual search
tasks.acceptance: Handle Russian, English, code-switched spelling and transliteration fixtures

tasks.title: Question feedback
tasks.acceptance: Allow helpful/not-helpful/incorrect citation buttons; store no public personal judgements

tasks.title: Latency target
tasks.acceptance: Pilot p95 <=8s without external generation on reference host; record hardware rather than inventing benchmarks

tasks.title: Adversarial prompt injection
tasks.acceptance: Treat quote/document content as evidence only; instructions embedded in messages never authorize tool actions

tasks.title: Gauntlet comparison
tasks.acceptance: Blind A/B vs configured unread outputs on gold questions; ours must preserve zero-ACL-leak gate and improve >=1 measured metric

tasks.title: Transcript ingestion
tasks.acceptance: Accept txt, vtt, srt with timestamps; speaker uncertain status recorded

tasks.title: Document ingestion
tasks.acceptance: Support PDF via pypdf, DOCX via python-docx, PPTX via python-pptx, MD/TXT natively

tasks.title: OCR gate
tasks.acceptance: Scanned PDF marked needs_ocr; no hidden third-party submission; optional manual OCR pipeline

tasks.title: Speech gate
tasks.acceptance: Use whisper.cpp as offline optional batch transcription after recording-consent approval

tasks.title: Meeting topic segments
tasks.acceptance: Chunk by times and topic transitions; maintain links back to original transcript and permission scope

tasks.title: Knowledge claim store
tasks.acceptance: Persist claims with evidence refs, asserted_by, extracted_at, valid_from and review_state

tasks.title: Supersession handling
tasks.acceptance: Correction creates new claim, invalidates dependent answers and marks earlier claim superseded

tasks.title: Evidence removal
tasks.acceptance: On deletion revoke excerpt, remove relevant embeddings/FTS, re-evaluate impacted claims and cached answer hashes

tasks.title: Source integrity
tasks.acceptance: SHA256 source binaries and normalized excerpts; preserve ingest and parsing version

tasks.title: Gold meeting evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Test 20 consented/synthetic meetings; >=95% cited snippets match timestamped transcript; no fabricated quotes

tasks.title: Skill taxonomy
tasks.acceptance: Seed 100 curated RU/EN skills plus synonyms; version schema and avoid opaque personality ranking

tasks.title: Consent by default
tasks.acceptance: Member profile undiscoverable until they explicitly opt in via bot

tasks.title: Import existing profiles
tasks.acceptance: Allow member-uploaded CV/CSV/LinkedIn export and admin-owned existing directory; no unauthorized scraping

tasks.title: Reviewable suggestions
tasks.acceptance: Auto-detected skills remain private suggestion pending member confirmation

tasks.title: Evidence categories
tasks.acceptance: Tag self_claim, validated_role, teaching_contribution, confirmed_help_outcome, weak_conversation_signal

tasks.title: Hard eligibility
tasks.acceptance: Filter membership, consent, skill match, availability, cooldown, visibility, conflicts before scoring

tasks.title: Ranking formula
tasks.acceptance: Among eligible candidates score 0.4 domain+0.25 helpfulness+0.15 evidence+0.1 context+0.1 load fairness; log components

tasks.title: No profiling abuse
tasks.acceptance: No personality, health, inferred private characteristics or unsolicited competence ratings

tasks.title: Profile correction
tasks.acceptance: Member can view, correct, hide, revoke and delete their discoverable profile and links

tasks.title: Expert gold set
tasks.acceptance: 30 approved test intents, precision@3 >=0.80 after member review; 100% opt-out respected

tasks.title: Intent capture
tasks.acceptance: /intro request creates need with short text, audience and lifespan; no mass unsolicited contact

tasks.title: Candidate capacity
tasks.acceptance: Default max 2 pending requests/member/week, and max 1 invitation at once per request

tasks.title: State machine
tasks.acceptance: requested>candidate_selected>invited>accepted>mutually_confirmed>scheduled>completed; terminal declined/expired/cancelled

tasks.title: Two-party consent
tasks.acceptance: Reveal no contact details before each party authorizes the introduction

tasks.title: Expiration
tasks.acceptance: Invitation expires after 72h; request expires after 14d; persisted UTC times with configurable display timezone

tasks.title: External effects
tasks.acceptance: Use outbox intent with effect_id, mark sent only with Telegram response; uncertain network result enters reconcile/manual mode

tasks.title: Calendar workaround
tasks.acceptance: Start with manual proposed slots or booking link; no Google/Microsoft OAuth in MVP

tasks.title: Reminders
tasks.acceptance: One reminder after 24h if opted in, never send after decline/cancel or contact-limit exhaustion

tasks.title: Outcome feedback
tasks.acceptance: Optional helpful/no response/decline feedback; do not expose private ratings

tasks.title: State-machine adversarial tests
tasks.acceptance: Exhaustive transition table, duplicate-click/replay, revoke-midflight, forbidden disclosure tests

tasks.title: Scheduled digest
tasks.acceptance: Default 09:00 Asia/Jerusalem, saved UTC next_fire_at using zoneinfo; DST simulation across transitions

tasks.title: Noisy-chat compression
tasks.acceptance: Use conversation episodes and distinct needs, not top-message counts or full message dump

tasks.title: Digest schema
tasks.acceptance: Topics, question/answer pairs, unresolved needs, correction notices, event references and cited source IDs

tasks.title: Consent and audience
tasks.acceptance: Member opt-in and per-group scope; no automatic forwarding of restricted-group information

tasks.title: Review before broadcast
tasks.acceptance: First pilot digests admin-only; public digest requires moderation approval until acceptance gate

tasks.title: Event intelligence
tasks.acceptance: D3-classified signals become draft moderator items, not automatic cold DMs

tasks.title: Change detection
tasks.acceptance: Compute added/updated/resolved needs and superseded claims since last successful digest

tasks.title: Reliability
tasks.acceptance: Job ledger ensures successful-day checkpoint only after delivery accepted or explicit reconciliation

tasks.title: Fallback digest
tasks.acceptance: If LLM unavailable, send deterministic source-link digest; no invented narrative

tasks.title: Digest evaluation
tasks.acceptance: >=95% valid citations, 0 restricted leaks, >=90% scheduled sends within 10 min over test schedule

tasks.title: Admin UI
tasks.acceptance: Jinja2+HTMX local/private UI: sources, pending profiles, evidence, jobs, audits, deletion requests

tasks.title: Access enforcement
tasks.acceptance: Telegram signed identity for member UI; admin session with CSRF defense and no public debug API

tasks.title: Operational metrics
tasks.acceptance: Ingest lag, classified rate, queued jobs, 429/5xx provider failures, citation errors, storage use, model cost

tasks.title: Secrets and data
tasks.acceptance: Environment/OS key store, never logs or tracker; locally encrypt backups and sessions

tasks.title: Service startup
tasks.acceptance: systemd unit with Restart=on-failure and explicit SQLite WAL shutdown/backup process

tasks.title: Backups
tasks.acceptance: Nightly SQLite online backup plus file hashes, off-host encrypted copy; monthly restore test

tasks.title: Data rights
tasks.acceptance: Member consent withdrawal triggers complete per-person derived data invalidation within policy deadline

tasks.title: Performance
tasks.acceptance: Record single-node RSS, disk and p95 Q&A under representative corpus; storage cost forecast

tasks.title: Documentation
tasks.acceptance: Write operator runbook, setup, privacy notice, deployment rollback and on-call page

tasks.title: Independent security review
tasks.acceptance: Separate reviewer tests ACL, egress guard, token leakage, intro state and recovery before production

tasks.title: Baseline freeze
tasks.acceptance: Capture immutable generation hash, database schema and fixture/evaluator hashes

tasks.title: Shadow pilot
tasks.acceptance: Run with synthetic or lawfully authorized pilot data, no automated publication or unsolicited matching

tasks.title: Provider contract gate
tasks.acceptance: NVIDIA production rights / privacy agreement and d3 processing permission documented, or local substitute engaged

tasks.title: Failure campaign
tasks.acceptance: Inject provider 429/503, restart, duplicate updates, disk-full, interrupted send and deletion during reindex

tasks.title: Golden QA
tasks.acceptance: Re-run locked 200-case gold suite; independent verifier owns labels and immutable harness

tasks.title: User validation
tasks.acceptance: At least 10 authorized pilot members try /ask, /expert and /intro; record task outcomes

tasks.title: Canary
tasks.acceptance: Enable 1 group and opt-in subset, shadow comparisons daily, rollback trigger on hard invariant

tasks.title: SLO dashboard
tasks.acceptance: Track acceptance, citation precision, p95 ingest and Q&A, delivery, member correction requests

tasks.title: Release decision
tasks.acceptance: Independent reviewer and community owner sign evidence bundle and approve release generation

tasks.title: Handoff
tasks.acceptance: Publish outstanding risks, owner, exact deployed commit, recovery procedure, and next revision backlog
